quarterly_data.quarter: Lite-On press release: LITEON Technology Reports Consolidated July Sales of NT$19 (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: July 2026 consolidated revenue NT$19 billion, up 2% M-o-M and 38% Y-o-Y; January-July cumulative sales NT$115.1 billion, up 27% Y-o-Y. The company attributes the growth to strong demand for AI and cloud computing high-end server power systems, backup battery units (BBU), networking power management systems and opto-electronic semiconductors. Segment mix: Cloud & AIoT 59% of sales, yearly growth about 80% on delivery growth of power management systems for high-end datacenter servers and cloud computing; Opto-electronics 15% of sales, over 20% Y-o-Y growth (photocouplers, infrared and visible LED indicators for AI servers and switches); Information Technology & Consumer Electronics 26% of sales, with demand for LEO satellite power systems and advanced power supplies continuing to grow steadily.
